title: BitNet b1.58: 1-Bit AI with Zero Matrix Multiplications

scenes.narration: What if frontier AI models didn't need power-hungry GPUs? Meet BitNet b1.58, the architecture that eliminates matrix multiplications entirely.

props.title: 1.58-Bit LLMs: BitNet
props.subtitle: Running billion-parameter AI without GPU matrix multiplications

scenes.narration: Standard neural networks rely on expensive floating-point multiplications. BitNet quantizes every single weight to just three values: minus one, zero, and plus one.

props.title: FP16 vs Ternary BitNet
leftPoints: Burns massive kilowatt power on GPUs
rightPoints: Up to 80% lower memory energy consumption
Runs large models natively on CPUs & phones

scenes.narration: Mathematically, weights are scaled by the mean absolute value, quantizing continuous weights into pure ternary states without degrading language capabilities.

props.title: Ternary Weight Quantization
props.explanation: Weights are normalized and rounded to the discrete set {-1, 0, +1}, turning matrix math into addition and subtraction.

scenes.narration: In code, the BitLinear layer replaces nn.Linear, quantizing inputs and weights into ternary values with pure integer arithmetic.
BitNet b1.58 is the blueprint for running high-performance LLMs on smartphones, laptops, and low-power edge chips.
